independent_lead_decisions.findings: The authority's exact 1076-2019 heading and description name VHDL and distinguish the LRM edition from the base language. IEEE 1076.1-2017 describes a separate VHDL-AMS extension.
limitations: The registry entity is the named language. The catalog is the supporting origin and describes a specific published edition.
independent_lead_decisions.method: Inspect the independently reacquired IEEE catalog's exact heading and main description, and challenge adjacent editions, syntactic relatives, and profile boundaries.
